title: Share state with a key
summary: useState creates state that Nuxt can share safely within one app visit.
introduction: useState creates state that Nuxt can share safely within one app visit. Your task: Read the same books-read key in another component.
learningObjectives: Read the same books-read key in another component.
Explain the example for share state with a key

blocks.text: useState creates state that Nuxt can share safely within one app visit. A key identifies which state value is being requested.
Use a Nuxt 3 project for these file paths. Examples go in the files named in comments. Remove the starter welcome screen and use NuxtPage in app.vue. Nuxt code needs its own build tool.
Read the code step by step

items: `useState` gives React a remembered value and a setter. Call the setter to ask React to show the next value.

blocks.text: The button updates the shared value named books-read.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not use a module-level changing ref as shared per-user server state. useState is designed for Nuxt rendering.
